messages:
Priya: Quick design review 1: I'm experimenting with a small "cost delta" badge that appears next to the min value when users change it, e.g. '+$12/mo'. Main asks: is this discoverable, does it conflict with the burst label, and any a11y concerns?

Jon: Love the instant feedback. Two accessibility notes: make it part of the spinbutton aria-valuetext so screen readers read the adjusted cost when value changes. Also ensure contrast >=4.5:1.

Adele: Visual hierarchy: badge is currently bright teal and competes with the burst pill. Suggest muted token (dark slate) and a tiny chevron that opens details. Keep text short: '+$12/mo'.

Marco: Interaction: when badge appears it currently shifts layout. Can we overlay it within the stepper container to avoid reflow? Also on mobile, ensure tap area >=44px.

Priya: Good — overlay inside container makes sense. For copy variants: short '+$12/mo', medium '+$12/mo estimate', long 'Estimated +$12 per month (final billing may vary)'. Which for aria-live? Jon?

Jon: Use short for visual, long for aria-live region that fires politely: 'Estimate increased by twelve dollars per month.' Keep aria-live offscreen but present in DOM.

Adele: Also add tooltip on hover/focus: 'Includes burst changes' linking to docs. Tooltip must be keyboard focusable.

ux-bot: Heuristics: (1) include badge in aria-valuetext, (2) use role=status aria-live=polite for verbal announcement, (3) reserve space to avoid layout shifts on narrow widths.

Marco: Dev note: debounce cost calc 300ms and show a spinner inside badge while waiting. If server fails, badge becomes '—' and a retry link appears.

Priya: Thanks! I'll update Figma: overlay badge, muted color, tooltip copy, aria-live copy. We'll test in the Friday usability session for discoverability and VoiceOver flow. :sparkles:
